limitations: Static reproduction implements the complete observed early-refusal paths, not unobserved successful admission/native behavior.

The four mode refusals first encounter symlinks (120000). Wcwidth additionally has a later unmaterialized gitlink (160000); its tree reconstruction uses the validated base-tree/index gitlink object ID and separately verifies an empty filesystem directory, rather than claiming submodule source-byte materialization.

SHA-1 object identity, pack/index checksums, base-only object materialization and worktree equality verify retained consistency; they do not establish authenticity of a remote repository independently of the retained transport/authority evidence.
